notes: The supplied pages contain no programme-specific information for Applied Data Science & Artificial Intelligence. Duration, teaching language, tuition and intake dates for this programme are not stated, so those facts are left out. The tuition table on the Collegegeld page gives institution fees in general and for other named programmes, not for ADS&AI, so no tuition figure can be quoted for a non-EU student on this programme. General application goes through Studielink, but no page names Studielink in the context of this specific programme, so applicationChannel is omitted. The language requirement quote concerns diplomas in general and the required language level (Dutch) is not specified; the applicant should treat this as a manual check.

note.fr: Vérifiez que votre diplôme étranger (Baccalauréat marocain) est comparable au diplôme néerlandais requis et que vous maîtrisez suffisamment le néerlandais ; contactez Team Admissions pour faire évaluer votre admissibilité.
note.en: Check whether your foreign diploma (Moroccan Baccalauréat) is comparable to the required Dutch diploma and whether you have sufficient command of Dutch; contact Team Admissions to have your eligibility assessed.

evidence.quote: Als je een buitenlands diploma hebt, dan moet deze vergelijkbaar zijn met het vereiste Nederlandse diploma én je moet de Nederlandse taal voldoende beheersen.
